items.definition:
a plastic disc thrown as a game or sport
They spent the afternoon throwing a frisbee in the park.

A red spice made from dried peppers.
I added a pinch of paprika to the goulash for color and flavor.

A marine crustacean, similar to a large shrimp.
I ordered a delicious prawn curry for dinner.

a task that needs to be done
I have a long list of to-dos for today.

a long, green-skinned squash, typically eaten as a vegetable
She added sliced zucchini to the stir-fry.

a woman who works in business
She is a successful businesswoman who owns several companies.

a sauce for salads; material applied to a wound
I prefer ranch dressing on my salad.

a boat propelled by sails
They spent the afternoon sailing on their new sailboat.

a party or occasion when a group of children or young people spend the night at a friend's house
My daughter is having a sleepover with her friends this weekend.

inflammation of the skin caused by overexposure to ultraviolet radiation from the sun
I got a terrible sunburn after spending all day at the beach.

a title at the head of a page or section
Please read the heading before you start the chapter.

a small citrus fruit
She peeled a tangerine for a snack.

a day on which work is done
My workday usually starts at 9 AM.

one of a pair of small, thin sticks used as eating utensils
He learned to eat with chopsticks.

a place on the coast where ships may find shelter
The ships docked safely in the harbour.

a sheet of paper with questions or exercises for a student
The teacher handed out a math worksheet to the class.

a shelf for holding books
She arranged her favorite novels neatly on the bookshelf.

A large, hairy bee.
A bumblebee buzzed around the flowers.

A container for keeping food and drink cool.
We packed drinks in the cooler for the picnic.

The state of being tired; fatigue
He felt a deep tiredness after the long journey.

a common European thrush, the male of which has black plumage and a yellow bill
A blackbird was singing loudly in the garden this morning.

a small North American thrush, the male of which has blue plumage
A bluebird landed on the fence post, its feathers a vibrant color.

a cutting tool with two blades
The tailor used a large pair of scissors to cut the fabric.

the process of taking one number or quantity away from another
Learning subtraction is a basic math skill.

a pot with a handle, spout, and lid, in which tea is brewed and served
She poured hot water into the teapot.

a small house built in a tree
The children loved playing in their treehouse.

A widely distributed weed of the daisy family, with a rosette of leaves, bright yellow flowers followed by fluffy white seed heads.
My lawn is full of dandelions in the spring.

identification
Can I see your ID, please?

a small, easy-to-peel citrus fruit
I packed a clementine in my lunch for a healthy snack.

A preserve made from citrus fruit, especially oranges.
I like to spread marmalade on my toast in the morning.

a hard, chewy candy made by boiling sugar and butter
She enjoyed a piece of sticky toffee after dinner.

chewy tapioca pearls, often found in bubble tea
I love bubble tea with extra boba.

a general medical examination
I have an annual checkup scheduled for next month.

mailman (a person who delivers mail)
The mailman delivers letters every weekday.

mitten (a type of glove that covers the four fingers together and the thumb separately)
She wore warm mittens to keep her hands from freezing.

a type of cured sausage
She made a sandwich with salami and cheese.

a person who owns or manages a shop
The friendly shopkeeper always greeted customers with a smile.

a large wading bird with long legs and a long bill
A stork built its nest on top of the chimney.

a coffee drink
I ordered a hot cappuccino with extra foam.

fire station
The firefighters returned to the firehouse after the call.

a long, white and green vegetable with a mild onion flavor
She added chopped leek to the soup for extra flavor.

a pizza restaurant
We decided to go to the new pizzeria for dinner.

the amount a spoon can hold
Add a spoonful of sugar to your tea.

a small dish eaten before the main course
We ordered spring rolls as an appetizer.

a pad of paper for writing notes; a simple text editor
I always carry a small notepad and pen with me.

Small pasta envelopes containing minced meat, cheese, or vegetables.
For dinner, we had ravioli with tomato sauce.

a utensil with a broad, flat, flexible blade
Use a spatula to flip the pancakes.

a stepfather
My stepdad taught me how to ride a bike.

A glossy white surface for writing on with marker pens.
Please write your ideas on the whiteboard.

A device used for lighting cigarettes or fires
He used a lighter to ignite the campfire.

A dish of beaten eggs cooked in a pan
She made a delicious cheese omelette for breakfast.

A book with exercises for students.
Please complete the exercises in your workbook.

A small panel of keys or buttons for operating a computer or other electronic device.
She entered the code on the keypad to unlock the door.

A dish of ground meat mixed with other ingredients and formed into a loaf.
My grandmother makes the best meatloaf.

a person whose job is to sell things
The salesperson helped me find the right size shoes.

a round, white or yellow root vegetable
She added chopped turnip to the vegetable stew.

a marker pen used to emphasize text
I used a yellow highlighter to mark the important points in the textbook.

a butter substitute made from vegetable oils
She spread margarine on her toast instead of butter.

a type of chewing gum that can be blown into bubbles
She blew a big bubble with her bubblegum.

a release of gas from the stomach through the mouth
He let out a loud burp after drinking the soda.

A nail of a toe
She painted her toenails red.

XXL (extra extra large)
He needed an XXL shirt because of his broad shoulders.

a miniature house for dolls
The little girl spent hours playing with her new dollhouse.

a sausage served in a long bun
We bought a hot dog and a soda at the baseball game.
